title: AI-Powered Social Calendar

contribution: Added shared schedules so friends can view each other's availability and book time directly, removing the guesswork of planning around someone else's schedule.
functionDescription: To turn plain-language to-dos into scheduled events and make shared planning easier

functionDescription: To match clients with qualified consultants through conversational search
